name: StarBorder-TS-TW

frames.best_why: Frame 3 shows both glows clearly, teal on the button and pink along the card edge.

tagline: Glowing sparks sweep around the edge of dark rounded buttons.
summary: Two dark rounded panels on black, one teal and one pink, with a soft coloured glow that slides along their top and bottom edges in a loop.
appearance: Two pill-shaped dark panels with near-black gradient faces, a short button label on one and a bold heading with grey paragraph on the other. A soft tinted bloom hugs part of each edge, teal on the small one and pink on the wide one.
behaviour: A blurred coloured spot travels back and forth along the top and bottom borders, fading as it goes, so each panel seems to have a spark circling it. The content itself never moves.
demo_content: Button "Get early access"; card heading "Launch week is live" with a line about five new components.
search_phrases: star sparkle along a button edge
soft light running around a panel
use_when: A call-to-action or small promo card needs to glow without a heavy animation.
avoid_when: It hardcodes a near-black face and white text, so it cannot sit on a light theme.
customise: Colour, animation duration and border thickness are props, plus the rendered element via as and any native props. The face gradient and text colours are fixed.
weight_why: Two blurred gradient divs animated by CSS keyframes; nothing runs in JavaScript.

a11y.note: The component renders a real button by default, but there is no focus styling and the looping glow ignores reduced-motion.

issues: The dark face and black-to-grey gradient are hardcoded, so it fights light themes.
In frame 1 the glows are barely visible and the border reads as plain.
polish_why: Tidy dark buttons with a gentle glow; the effect is subtle enough to look almost static.
title: Star Border
